location.ref: dohā 'ajgar karai na cākrī, panchī karai na kām …'

paraphrase: The python does no service, the bird does no work; Dās Malūkā has said it: Rām is the giver of all.
speaker: Malūkdās

original.text: ajagara karai na cākarī, paṃchī karai na kāma; dāsa malūkā kahi gaye, saba ke dātā rāma
original.edition: popular printed and sung form; wording varies between editions and singers

translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Very widely quoted; often cited (against its intent) as praise of idleness — the tradition reads it as trust in providence.
